invariants: Every canonical TerminologyId has exactly one Turkish and one English label.
Ascendant/Yükselen and House/Ev are fixed canonical mappings.
Professional Vedik terms such as Nakshatra, Ayanamsha, Dasha and Pada are retained instead of being arbitrarily renamed.
Optional preferredTechnicalLabel may supplement, but never silently replace, the canonical TR/EN label.
Unsupported locale tags fail closed instead of leaking or guessing another language.
remaining_before_done: All production UI/PDF/notification surfaces must consume this glossary or prove equivalent canonical IDs rather than hard-code divergent terminology.
Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
Final TR/EN localization audit must prove there are no conflicting duplicate translations outside the glossary.
